items.q: Sammy Hodges on drums -- no relation to Johnny Hodges

ctx.x: Oh, the guy that went with Claude Hopeton.
With Claude Hopeton (unintelligible) Billy Taylor was on bass. Sammy Hodges on drums -- no relation to Johnny Hodges -- Paul Bernett was on (banjo) (unintelligible).
